description: All sensors on Duckbot: what they measure, where they sit, and their specs. Used later to add matching sensors to the MuJoCo model.

sensors.name: imu_body
sensors.description: 6-axis IMU (3-axis gyroscope + 3-axis accelerometer). Gives the body's tilt (from gravity) and rotation speed for balancing and walking.

mount.note: Mount firmly near the middle of the box body, ideally on foam tape to damp servo vibration. Exact position and axis orientation not decided yet.

temperature.note: Die temperature, for gyro drift compensation.

does_not_measure: heading (no magnetometer: yaw drifts over time)
sensors.onboard_motion_processor: DMP (can compute orientation on-chip; awkward to set up)

interface.address_note: Set by the AD0 pin, so at most two MPU6050s per I2C bus.

sensors.supply_note: The GY-521 board has an on-board regulator.
sensors.processing_needed: Fuse gyro and accelerometer (complementary or Madgwick filter) to get tilt. Calibrate the gyro offset at startup while the robot stands still.
sensors.spec_note: Noise densities are from the InvenSense MPU-6050 datasheet; clone chips on cheap GY-521 boards can be noisier.

sensors.name: servo_feedback
sensors.description: Built into every servo (see parts/sts3215.json). Read over the servo bus.
